title: The Living Lab at HIT
summary: A real-life home environment for developing and testing smart-home and assistive technologies that support health, independence and quality of life.
description:
The **Living Lab at HIT** develops and tests **smart-home and assistive technologies** in a real-life setting, to improve health, independence and quality of life.

- **Advanced environment** — IoT devices, sensors and intelligent robots allow seamless data collection, monitoring and natural interaction in everyday settings.
- **Applied research** — researchers and developers use the lab to evaluate human–technology interaction, test new healthcare and cognitive-support systems, and refine AI-driven home automation.
- **Research ecosystem** — all experiments and data from the Living Lab feed into HIT's research ecosystem, supporting evidence-based development and multidisciplinary innovation.

Projects tested here include the [TEMI Robot Cognitive Support System](/projects/temi-cognitive-support).
